quests.title: Connor's Brew

dialogue.sit: A little bird told me that someone wants Mist Flower Corollas...

dialogue.t: Ah, you must have seen that commission of mine. So, do you have those three Mist Flower Corollas handy?
My, my... These Mist Flower Corollas are of fine quality indeed.
Please, take these — consider them a token of my appreciation.

quests.description: The Dawn Winery’s Connor requires three Mist Flower Corollas.
